Subject: Accelerator cohort — ask for extended promo credits

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team at Maya Labs is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the KV caching features. We're running in a university accelerator (Launchpad Summer '27) and the program covers tooling credits for a select set of vendors.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood make a one-time promotional exception to increase the cohort credit pool from the standard $5k to $12k for our cohort (roughly 18 teams)?
- If a larger pool isn't possible, can you prorate credits per team (we'd take a mix of two larger credits + several smaller grants) and extend the validity from 60 to 120 days?

We're on a short timeline — applications go live next week — and we'd like to list Redwood as a preferred cloud/inference partner if we can make this work. I can provide cohort roster and a PO if needed.

- Validity: approved for 90 days (we can grant a one-time 30-day extension on request with a short justification).
- Require a signed PR/PO for the cohort and a short co-marketing blurb if you list Redwood as "preferred".

I'll loop in Lauren (partner programs lead) and Ben (finance) to confirm the above and finalize the paperwork.

Markus / Lauren — reviewed. Finance is comfortable with a $10k cohort pool under these constraints:
- Term: 90 days from issuance, single 30-day extension allowed with written justification from the accelerator.
- Allocation: up to two $3k awards, up to six $500 awards; remaining balance reserved for internal approvals (we don't auto-issue more than the pool).
- Requirement: signed PO/PR referencing deal id DL-202704-MAYA-12 and standard promo T&Cs (no credits redeemable for cash).
- Clawback: if program fails to onboard at least 8 teams to Redwood within 120 days, finance reserves the right to recoup or reassign remaining credits.

I've attached the short approval doc with standardized language — legal has OK'd the copy. Once you confirm, Markus, I can prepare the DocuSign envelope and the PO template.
